label: Women with elevated loneliness, depression, and anxiety symptoms
summary: This profile represents respondents with comparatively higher self-reported loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms across the measured indicators.
demographic_anchor: Female respondents, typically with graduate-level education or above, and associated with the 1-3 hours category.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively high loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows elevated depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9
Shows elevated anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7
Most commonly anchored to female respondents with higher educational attainment
tone: Psychologically distressed, socially disconnected, and emotionally strained

label: Low Distress, Highly Educated Male
summary: This profile reflects respondents with comparatively low loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms. The pattern suggests generally better emotional well-being relative to higher-distress groups in the sample.

behavior_markers: Reports relatively low loneliness on the UCLA-8 indicator.
Shows comparatively low depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9.
Shows comparatively low anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7.
Anchored demographically by men with graduate-level education or higher.
Associated with the 1-3 hours category in the profile summary.

label: Highly distressed, heavy-use female graduates
summary: This profile is characterized by comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms, alongside heavy daily use. It represents women with graduate-level education or above who report more than 5 hours of use.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate education or above, more than 5 hours of use
behavior_markers: Associated with heavy daily use of more than 5 hours
